intro.title: Before you start
intro.privacyTitle: Your data stays on this computer
intro.privacy: Claude Memory Sync processes everything on this computer only. It does not connect to the internet and sends no memories, chats or files to any server or cloud service. There are no accounts, analytics or usage data. Your data leaves this computer only when you move a bundle or backup yourself.
intro.icloud: If Desktop or Documents is synced with iCloud, macOS, not the app, syncs the bundles and full backups saved there.
intro.foldersTitle: macOS will now ask about three folders

why.desktop: Bundles and full backups are saved here by default, and bundles here are found.
why.documents: Workspace files are found and backed up, and projects are matched to their counterparts on the other device by their git remotes.
why.downloads: Bundles you download from another device are found automatically.

intro.denied: Without them, memories, chats and Claude settings are still backed up and transferred; they live in the Claude folder, which needs no permission. Workspace files and bundles in a folder you do not allow are not seen, and projects there are not matched by themselves on import; bundles can still be opened by choosing the file and saved to another folder. You can allow access later in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders.
intro.again: macOS may ask again with every new version of the app.

help.title: Backup types
help.summary: In short: Back up now and the schedule keep this device's history in the encrypted backup folder; Full backup is one file, for before you reset or replace the computer.
help.before: Taken automatically before every import, restore, undo and workspace fix, into the same folder. Whatever Backup contents says, it holds every memory, workspace file and Claude setting; Undo in History goes back to these. The newest 50 are kept.
help.full: Taken with Full backup, before you reset or replace the computer: every memory and chat, the rest of Claude's data, the app's settings, version history, matches and activity log, in one file. Keep it off the computer; opening it on a fresh install continues where you left off. The backup folder stays apart: open it again with its password.
help.export: Made in Transfer → Create bundle, for another device. Only the memories and workspaces you pick go in, and the other device merges them both ways.
help.backup: Taken by the schedule and with Back up now, into the encrypted backup folder. Each holds what you chose in Backup contents as it was at that moment, and stores only what changed since the one before. Restore this backup takes you back to that moment. Kept: every one of the last day, one a day for a month, one a week after that.

full.title: Full backup before resetting the computer
full.intro: Every memory and chat, workspace files, Claude settings and the rest of Claude's data (Claude Code settings, MCP servers, plugins, scheduled tasks, Cowork sessions), and the app's settings, version history, matches and activity log go into one file. Logins are not included: sign in to Claude again on the new install. After the reset, install the app and open this file: everything goes back where it was. The backups stay in their backup folder; open it again with its password.

ws.intro: The repositories each workspace opens were looked for on this device. Workspaces whose repositories are here come selected; you can select the others if you want. The ones you leave unselected are offered again at the next import.
ws.selectFound: Select the ones with repositories here
ws.noChanges: There are no workspace changes to take.

same.one: {count} workspace is the same on both devices
same.other: {count} workspaces are the same on both devices

kept.one: {count} workspace stays as it is on this device
kept.other: {count} workspaces stay as they are on this device

ws.foldersUnreadable: The folders it opens could not be read

restore.updated: To replace with the bundle's version

confirm.nothing: There are no files to write or delete. Finish only records that this bundle was seen.
confirm.chatsNote: No chat on this device is deleted or shortened. Undo does not remove the chats brought in.
confirm.safe1: 1. This device's files are backed up first, encrypted, into: {path}
confirm.safe2: 2. Each file is written to a temporary file and moved into place in one step. If a file fails, everything done up to that point is undone.
confirm.safe3: 3. When it is done, every file is read back and checked. It can be undone in one click from History.
confirm.closeSessions: If a Claude Code session is open in these projects, close it first; an open session may write to the memory at the same time.
confirm.groups: Groups to set up in the Claude desktop app: {names}
confirm.groupsNote: A copy of Claude's settings file is kept first. Don't open Claude until this is done.
confirm.noBackups: Backups are not set up. Every change is backed up first, so nothing can be written until they are.

result.nothing: This device already matched the bundle; the bundle was recorded as seen.
result.summary: {changes}; every file was read back and verified.

copies.one: {count} conflict copy was created (like file--{device}.md) and listed in MEMORY.md. You can ask Claude to merge it into the original file.
copies.other: {count} conflict copies were created (like file--{device}.md) and listed in MEMORY.md. You can ask Claude to merge them into the original files.

result.exportBack: Create a bundle from this device (to send back)
result.groupsSet: Their groups are set up in the Claude desktop app: {names}.
result.groupsLeft: Their groups were not set up: {names}. {reason} Open this bundle again while Claude is closed, and only the groups are set up.

export.scratch: Claude sessions without a folder: sessions you opened in the Claude desktop app without choosing a folder. On the other device they go to Claude's own folder.
export.noRoots: No scan folders. You can add one on the Workspaces screen.
export.wsHint: Files you leave unticked stay out of the bundle; their copies on the other device are left as they are.
export.chooseFolder: Folder to save the bundle to
export.readOnly: Creating a bundle does not change any file on this device.
export.step1: 1. Move this file to the other device (USB drive, AirDrop, email, cloud folder).
export.step2: 2. On the other device, open Claude Memory Sync and double-click the file, or choose it in Transfer → Import bundle.
export.step3: 3. There, every change is shown for approval before it is imported, and that device is backed up first as well.
export.groups: Groups in the Claude desktop app: picking a group picks its chats and their projects' memory.
export.groupSub: Its chats, side chats and their projects' memory · {size}
export.projectsSub: Each row is a project. Its box picks the project's memory; a click on the row shows its chats. A chat you pick goes with its project's memory.
export.scratchMoved: the session moved to {folder}, its memory stayed here
export.noProjects: No project on this device has a memory or a chat.

groups.running: Claude is running, and while it runs it writes its own settings over the file.
groups.unknown: It could not be told whether Claude is closed.
groups.failed: Claude's settings file could not be read.

settings.sub: Settings apply to this device only; they do not change the other device's settings.

device.title: This device
device.name: Device name
device.nameSub: Shown in bundles and in the names of conflict copies (e.g. note--macbook.md).
device.claudeDirSub: If the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable is set, that folder is used.
device.appDataSub: Settings, version history and activity log.

backup.title: Backups
backup.sub: Encrypted, and each backup stores only what changed. You choose what scheduled and manual backups take in Backup contents.
backup.removeTitle: Remove the backups from the app?
backup.removeText: The backup folder and every backup in it stay where they are, and open again with Open an existing backup. Until backups are set up again, nothing is imported, restored or undone.
backup.removed: Removed from the app; the backup folder is as it was.

app.title: App
app.languageSub: With the system language selected, the app opens in the computer's language.
app.themeSub: With System, the app follows the computer's light or dark appearance.
app.openAtLoginSub: Starts in the menu bar or system tray, without opening the window.
app.openAtLoginDev: Works only in the installed app (no effect in development mode).
app.background: Keep running when the window is closed
app.backgroundSub: The app has to be running to take the daily backup. When it keeps running, quit from the menu bar or tray menu.

bundle.title: Bundle contents
bundle.sub: What goes into bundles for other devices by default. You can also choose item by item when creating a bundle.
bundle.claudeSub: CLAUDE.md, agents, commands, skills and output-styles under ~/.claude, except skills/synced, which comes from the Claude account.
bundle.scratchSub: Memories of sessions opened in the Claude desktop app without a folder; on the other device they go to Claude's own folder. A session whose chat is picked always takes its memory.
bundle.excludedNone: None. Projects are chosen on the Memories screen.

dirs.title: Where bundles are looked for
dirs.sub: The Desktop, Downloads and the backup folder are always scanned. Add a cloud folder or a USB drive, and bundles there are found too.
dirs.choose: Folder to look for bundles in (e.g. a cloud folder or USB drive)

about.title: About
about.sub: Moves and backs up Claude Code memories, workspace files and Claude settings between devices, without losing anything.

github.sub: The app's source code and who makes it
github.author: Developer
github.issuesSub: Open an issue on GitHub for a bug or an idea.
github.licenseSub: MIT: free to use, change and share.

text.off: Only when you back up by hand
